settings.heading: Three steps. No bottle in sight.
settings.lede: A MOVO Boost pouch sits between your lip and gum and releases electrolytes as it moistens. That’s the whole routine — there’s nothing to mix, measure, or carry.

settings.title: Pop it in
settings.summary: Place one pouch between lip and gum.
settings.detail: Either side, upper or lower — wherever it sits comfortably. You’ll feel a light tingle as it settles. That’s the pouch starting to release.
settings.image_alt: A person holding a MOVO Boost pouch up to their mouth

settings.title: Keep moving
settings.detail: Leave it in until the flavor fades, while you train, drive, travel or work. Hands stay free and nothing needs to be cleaned up afterwards.
settings.image_alt: A runner mid-stride on a sunlit path

settings.title: Hydrate anywhere
settings.detail: When you’re done, throw the used pouch away — don’t swallow it. The tin holds 18 and fits in a pocket, so the next one is always on you.
settings.image_alt: A MOVO Boost tin being slipped into a trouser pocket

settings.heading: The short version
settings.body: Four things worth knowing before your first pouch.

settings.title: 2 hours
settings.body: That’s the sweet spot per pouch. You can also take it out once the flavor fades.

settings.title: Don’t swallow it
settings.body: The pouch itself is not meant to be swallowed. Remove it and throw it away.

settings.title: Still drink water
settings.body: MOVO Boost tops up electrolytes. It does not replace the fluid your body needs.

settings.title: Up to 4 a day
settings.body: One is plenty for normal exercise, but we do not suggest more than 4 in a day.

settings.heading: Still have questions?
settings.body: We’ve answered the fifteen we get asked most — from daily limits to what happens if someone swallows one.
